description: Delete a saved template or hashtag set for good (undo can't bring it back). Posts that used it keep their text. Agents get a two-step: the first call returns CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED with a confirm_token; ask the user, then call again with it.

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name: template_delete
title: Delete a template
